description:
Land Acquisition - Yodagama, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District - Amended Ex. Gaz. No. 1990/45 dated 28.10.2016 Maritimepattu D/S Division, Mullaitvu District
Sec. 07
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of the land lots, their locations, and compensation procedures. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
